snippet.title: You're Alive, Phil - Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
You're Alive Phil is my first commercial game. It's a casual puzzle game with a fully narrated story. Follow the life of Phil, an unexpectedly sentient rock, as he comes to terms with his existence.

You can wishlist the game on Steam right NOW https://store.steampowered.com/app/4708400/Youre_Alive_Phil/
